study type: Case-control (ex vivo tissue analysis) and in vitro experimental study
cohort: The study included placental tissues from preeclampsia patients and controls, and HTR-8/SVneo trophoblast cell lines.
finding: The downregulation of ANXA2 significantly contributes to the pathogenesis of preeclampsia by impairing trophoblast invasion and migration via inhibition of the b-catenin signaling pathway.
cross-section timing: At time of delivery for placental samples
